items.rationale: A digits value of -2 rounds to the nearest 100. 2,374.25 is closer to 2,400 than to 2,300, so the result is 2400.
Negative digits count places to the left of the decimal point: -1 is tens, -2 is hundreds. It does not change the sign and it is not an error.
Each ROUND returns 10, and ROUND stores the new value. The sum of the three rounded cells is 30, not the raw 31.2.
ROUND sends a value that is exactly halfway away from zero, so 2.5 becomes 3. Banker's rounding to 2 is not used.
